tournament_name: Phase C — 6-Step UI & Frontend Component Architecture Tournament
winner_name: Winning Candidate U5: Frontier AI Research Lab Hybrid Console (Anthropic / OpenAI Evals + Tufte + Fluent React)

components_analyzed.name: Top System Telemetry & Live Protocol Bar
components_analyzed.role: Global system online indicator, Go warm p50/p95 latency readout, Qdrant sync badge, keyboard shortcut legend, and 1-click TBC llms.txt export.
db_laws: Universal Principles of Design (107 Legibility & Visibility of System Status)
Refactoring UI (Flipping the contrast: dark obsidian status bar anchoring light canvas)

components_analyzed.name: Architectural Masthead & 4-Cell KPI Telemetry Strip
components_analyzed.role: Executive identity header paired with a 4-cell tabular metric strip (Holdout NDCG@10 83.4%, CRAG 12/12 OOD, 55+ Spec-Drift Hazards, 24/24 Red-Team Pass).
db_laws: Information Dashboard Design (Single-screen eye-span summary without heavy grid boxes or gauges)
Fullstack D3 (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums / 'tnum' 1 for vertical decimal alignment)

components_analyzed.name: Segmented Index Navigation & Keyboard Command Router
components_analyzed.role: 4-workspace tab switcher with monospace index badges (01..04), ARIA attribute styling ([aria-selected='true']), and instant keyboard hotkeys (Alt+1..4 or 1..4).
db_laws: Inclusive Components (Form follows function via ARIA attribute selectors & direct Tab focus)
Refactoring UI (Emphasize by de-emphasizing inactive tabs)

components_analyzed.name: Prompt Command Console & Stratified Preset Matrix
components_analyzed.role: Interactive query command bar with '/' quick-focus hotkey, bank scope selector, and color-coded preset chips separating normal API queries from adversarial OOD/PII traps.
db_laws: Laws of UX 2e (Fitts's Law target sizing & Jakob's Law terminal prompt affordance)
Strategic Writing for UX (Verb+Object microcopy on action buttons: 'Execute 3-Way Eval')

components_analyzed.name: 3-Way Side-by-Side Retrieval Evaluation Arena
components_analyzed.role: Simultaneous 3-column comparison (Mode A llms.txt vs Mode B Vector RAG vs Mode C Hybrid) with inline CRAG confidence meter bars, score delta badges, and lateral alignment.
db_laws: Visualization Analysis and Design (Eyes Beat Memory in Side-by-Side Juxtaposed Views)
Interaction of Color (Lateral left-right contact aligns with natural visual comparison)

components_analyzed.name: Result Evidence Card, Inline Score Bar & Citation Footprint
components_analyzed.role: Individual retrieval hit card displaying rank, tabular score bar, bank pill, hazard flags (Deprecated/Basic-Bearer/Path-Drift), deep doc link, and monospace code/doc snippet.
db_laws: The Shape of AI (Pattern 21 Synthesis & Pattern 46 Caveat: pair results with exact Citations & Footprints)
Refactoring UI (Dark colored text on light tinted badge backgrounds so badges don't hijack hierarchy)

components_analyzed.name: CRAG [] Hallucination Abstention & Rail-1 Privacy Banner
components_analyzed.role: High-salience feedback banner showing microsecond Georgian IBAN/PAN redaction and Mode C's strict [] abstention when CRAG confidence < 0.646.
db_laws: The Shape of AI (Explicit uncertainty & abstention state vs silent hallucination)
Elements of Color (Light-dark brilliance separation preventing simultaneous contrast vibration)

components_analyzed.name: 4-Rail Security Firewall Inspector & 24-Vector Red-Team Matrix
components_analyzed.role: Dark code payload buffer + 4-rail violation breakdown with exact contract remediation + interactive 24-row red-team matrix (click row to load payload).
db_laws: Practical Typography & Fullstack D3 (Borderless zebra-striped data table with right-aligned tabular microseconds)
Fluent React (Event delegation on table tbody + DocumentFragment single-reflow batch render)

components_analyzed.name: Head-to-Head Bank Readiness Cards & Spec-Drift Hazard Explorer
components_analyzed.role: Side-by-side BOG vs TBC AI-readiness scorecards + filterable 55+ live portal hazard table with severity pills and 1-click remediation copy.
db_laws: Information Dashboard Design (Muted horizontal dividers, zero heavy vertical cell cages)
Defensive CSS (min-width: 0 and overflow-wrap: anywhere on long OpenAPI slugs)

components_analyzed.name: Phase A Holdout Leaderboard, Crisp SVG Slopegraph & Live MCP Console
components_analyzed.role: 7-architecture Holdout tournament table, Tufte trajectory slopegraph with direct data labels, and live JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP wire inspector.
db_laws: Visual Display of Quantitative Information (High data-ink ratio slopegraph & direct line labeling)
Using SVG with CSS3 and HTML5 (Crisp orthogonal guide lines, smooth anti-aliased data slopes)

leaderboard.name: Winning Candidate U5: Frontier AI Research Lab Hybrid Console (Anthropic / OpenAI Evals + Tufte + Fluent React)
leaderboard.description: Dual-Polarity Architectural Precision: Obsidian Top Telemetry Bar (#090A0F) + Dark Monospace Payload Buffers (#0D1017) anchoring a High-Luminance Alabaster Stone Evaluation Canvas (#F5F5F2) and Crisp White Data Surfaces (#FFFFFF). Enforces Concentric Radius Law (R_outer=10px, Padding=6px header/frame or R_outer=10px, Padding=4px -> R_inner=6px), Inline Score Meter Bars + Rank Delta Badges in the 3-Way Arena, CRAG Threshold Gauge (0.646 cutoff marker), Keyboard Hotkeys ('/' focus query, '1'-'4' switch views), DocumentFragment Single-Reflow DOM Batching, and Event Delegation.

leaderboard.name: Candidate U4: Monochrome High-Contrast Developer Console (Geist / Linear)
leaderboard.description: Pure monochrome slate/white surface hierarchy with subtle borders, keyboard command bar, and dark code buffers. Clean aesthetic, but lacks inline visual score bars and semantic bank differentiation.

leaderboard.name: Candidate U3: Swiss Neo-Brutalist Exposed 1px Hairline Grid
leaderboard.description: Sharp 0px radius exposed 1px structural grid (Müller-Brockmann style) with monospace coordinates. High architectural clarity, but heavy 4-sided cell borders lower Tufte data-ink ratio in large tables.

leaderboard.name: Candidate U1: Warm Daylight Editorial Paper (Initial Phase C Design)
leaderboard.description: Warm cream canvas (#FAF8F5) with deep navy accents (#0B3B66), 14px rounded cards, WCAG-verified badges, and safe DOM creation, but low technical density and soft consumer-blog feel.

leaderboard.name: Candidate U2: Pure Dark Neon Terminal (#050505 + Neon Cyan/Green)
leaderboard.description: Full dark-mode console (#050505) with glowing neon borders. High developer novelty, but suffers from halation/light-bleed on dense 473-doc prose tables and equal-lightness hue vibration.

leaderboard.name: Baseline U0: Generic Bootstrap Card Stack & Proportional Fonts
leaderboard.description: Standard multi-card layout with heavy 1px black table borders, drop shadows, proportional numerals in tables, innerHTML string concatenation, and dark saturated badges with white text.

loo_ablation.feature: Dual-Polarity Anchor (Obsidian Telemetry & Code Buffers + Alabaster Stone Eval Canvas)
loo_ablation.source_law: Refactoring UI (Flipping the contrast) + Universal Principles (Legibility Polarity)
loo_ablation.decision: KEEP (Prevents eye fatigue on 473-doc tables while keeping code/telemetry razor-sharp)

loo_ablation.feature: Inline Visual Score Bars & CRAG 0.646 Threshold Meter inside 3-Way Arena Cards
loo_ablation.source_law: Munzner (Eyes Beat Memory in Side-by-Side Views) + The Shape of AI (Uncertainty Cues)
loo_ablation.decision: KEEP (Lets engineers see at a glance why Mode C's 0.84 score beats Mode B's 0.52 or abstains below 0.646)

loo_ablation.feature: Strict Tabular Numerals (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` + `'tnum' 1`) & Right-Aligned Metric Columns
loo_ablation.source_law: Wattenberger Fullstack D3 (Ch. 9 p. 321) + Butterick Practical Typography
loo_ablation.decision: KEEP (Eliminates horizontal decimal jitter across latency, NDCG@10, and microsecond columns)

loo_ablation.feature: DocumentFragment Single-Reflow Batch Insertion + Single Event-Delegated Table Listeners
loo_ablation.source_law: Tejas Kumar Fluent React (Ch. 3 DocumentFragment) + Zakas High Performance JS
loo_ablation.decision: KEEP (Collapses 55+ audit row insertions and 24 red-team rows into 1 DOM reflow and 1 listener)

loo_ablation.feature: Soft Tinted Semantic Badges (Dark Text `#065F46`/`#991B1B`/`#1E3A8A` on Light Pill Surface)
loo_ablation.source_law: Refactoring UI (Ch. 5 p. 164: dark text on light colored background for secondary badges)
loo_ablation.decision: KEEP (Achieves APCA |Lc| >= 75 without loud saturated pills stealing focus from primary titles)

loo_ablation.feature: Borderless Horizontal-Only Data Tables (Removing Vertical Cell Cages & Heavy Drop Shadows)
loo_ablation.source_law: Stephen Few Information Dashboard Design (Ch. 8 p. 152) + Tufte Data-Ink Ratio
loo_ablation.decision: KEEP (Maximizes data-pixel ratio so eyes track effortlessly across wide 9-column Holdout tables)

loo_ablation.feature: Keyboard Command Shortcuts (`/` to focus query, `1`-`4` to switch views, `Enter` to execute) + `:focus-visible`
loo_ablation.source_law: Inclusive Components (Heydon Pickering) + Laws of UX 2e (Fitts's & Jakob's Law)
loo_ablation.decision: KEEP (Delivers genuine frontier-lab keyboard velocity for senior engineers testing the bench)

loo_ablation.feature: Decorative Card Drop-Shadows & Animated Background Gradients
loo_ablation.decision: DROP / KILLED BY ABLATION (Adds visual clutter and paint overhead without encoding any data)
